subject: Final rollout coordination & calendar alignment for FinServCo cutover
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finservco.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-03T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Final rollout coordination & calendar alignment for FinServCo cutover

Hi Tom —

Following up from last week's demo, we'd like to lock in a final rollout/cutover planning call for the week of Aug 14. Goal: agree owners, fallback policies, and the cutover runbook so your team has a clear playbook for the go-live. Proposed agenda (30–60 min):

- 10m: Quick status (PO, infra confirmation)
- 20m: Cutover steps & owners (who executes each step)
- 15m: Fallback & mitigation policies
- 10m: Security & procurement checklist / next steps

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue Aug 17 — 10:00–11:00
- Wed Aug 18 — 13:00–14:00
- Thu Aug 19 — 08:30–09:30

If none of these work, please suggest 2 windows that fit your engineering and procurement teams. Marcus (AE) and Dev (SE) will attend from our side; Evelyn (security) should join for the security/ops section.

Before the call we'll send a one-page runbook and SOC2 evidence summary. Also flagging procurement — if Priya (or procurement@finservco.com) should be on the invite please loop them in.

Thanks — looking forward to finalizing timing so we can send calendar invites and the pre-read.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finservco.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@finservco.com>, FinServCo Procurement <procurement@finservco.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T12:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final rollout coordination & calendar alignment for FinServCo cutover

Laura — thanks for the clear agenda. High level constraints from our side:

- Our core infra team is heads-down Mon–Tue mornings.
- Procurement needs the final SOW and invoice estimate before they can commit to a PO — Priya is copied.
- Security (my team) can attend but prefers an earlier slot PST to fit the daily standups.

From the proposed slots, Wed Aug 18 13:00 PDT is tough. Can you do Wed Aug 18 at 10:00–11:00 PDT instead, or Thu Aug 19 08:30–09:30 is ok for us. If you need a separate 20–30m pre-read security sync, happy to schedule that the day before (we can do Tue Aug 17 09:00–09:30).

Also looping procurement and Priya so they can confirm PO timelines.

Thanks —
Tom Reynolds
Platform Engineering Lead, FinServCo
tom.reynolds@finservco.com | +1 (212) 555-8890

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finservco.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-04T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final rollout coordination & calendar alignment for FinServCo cutover

Thanks Tom — appreciate the constraints. Quick notes from AE/ops side:

- We can do Wed Aug 18 10:00–11:00 PDT. I've tentatively held that on my calendar pending confirmation from procurement.
- Dev will join for the full session; he recommends we split the meeting: first 40m to cover cutover owners + step-by-step runbook, then a 20m block for procurement/security so those threads stay focused.

Attached is our latest rollout_checklist_v3.pdf — it's the working runbook we've been iterating on. Key items still outstanding:
1) Final PO number from procurement
2) IP allowlist confirmation (network-diagram.png)
3) Acceptance criteria sign-off (we'll put this into the HubSpot deal record)

If procurement confirms by EOD Tue Aug 10, we can circulate the DocuSign SOW and lock the PO before the call.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0177

Date: 2026-08-04T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Final rollout coordination & calendar alignment for FinServCo cutover

Laura / team — quick security ops notes before we finalize the invite: 

- I'll send a 1-page SOC2-summary.pdf as a pre-read. Please confirm who on the FinServCo side needs the full report; if they want the SOC2 Type II we will route through our compliance channel (takes ~48 hours).
- Confirm whether the cutover uses customer-managed network rules (FinServCo) or Redwood-managed tunneling — this affects the timing for IP allowlist changes. The network-diagram.png in Marcus' thread would help.
- Recommendation: add a 20-min pre-ops call on Tue Aug 17 09:00–09:20 PDT for security & infra owners only to review firewall/allowlist and rollback triggers. That avoids eating into the full runbook meeting.

Short reply is fine — need to know if the pre-ops slot is acceptable and whether procurement will commit to a PO by Aug 10.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Subject: Confirmed: Wed Aug 18 10:00–11:00 PDT (Pre-ops Tue Aug 17 09:00–09:20) — FinServCo cutover planning

Thanks everyone — locking these in per availability. Final calendar invites (Zoom links below) will be sent from my calendar and added to the HubSpot deal record. Please treat the pre-ops as required for security/infra owners.

Confirmed schedule (PDT):
- Tue Aug 17 09:00–09:20 — Pre-ops (security & infra owners only) — Zoom: https://redwoodinference.app/zoom/meet/finservco-preops-aug17
- Wed Aug 18 10:00–11:00 — Cutover planning & runbook (owners, procurement, security) — Zoom: https://redwoodinference.app/zoom/meet/finservco-cutover-aug18

Owners (initial):
- Cutover coordinator: Tom Reynolds (FinServCo)
- Redwood exec sponsor: Marcus Lin (AE)
- SE lead / rollback owner: Dev Patel
- Security & compliance: Evelyn Hart
- Procurement contact: Priya Singh (FinServCo)

Fallback policy summary (short):
- If any critical infra check fails during the cutover window, trigger immediate rollback to snapshot T-1 and open incident with owners above.
- If FinServCo cannot complete IP allowlist changes within the maintenance window, Redwood will host a temporary tunneling endpoint for up to 4 hours to allow verification (requires pre-signed change request).

Next steps:
- Marcus: circulate DocuSign SOW by EOD Mon Aug 10 (DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/s/FS-2026-0814)
- Priya / procurement: confirm PO number by EOD Mon Aug 10
- Tom: confirm primary and backup cutover execs on your side

I'll attach the final rollout_checklist_v3.pdf and SOC2-summary.pdf to the calendar invites. If anything changes, respond here and we'll update the invites.

— Laura
